name: trade-account-application
title: Trade account application
description: A dealer or trade account request: company and VAT details, business type, expected spend and a reference, then what happens next.
docs: onSubmit(values) receives the company name, registration number, VAT number (cleaned, in capitals), country code, contact name, job title, email, phone, the businessType and monthlySpend values, the attached reference File or null and acceptedTerms. Return a string to say the shop could not take it: it is shown at the top and every answer stays. Return nothing, or resolve, and the form is replaced by the confirmation. The checks run on send: company, registration and VAT numbers (two letters, then the number), country, name, email, a phone with at least six digits when one is given, the type, the spend and the terms. The problems are listed in a group at the top that takes focus and links to each field, and a field that shows one is checked again as it changes. businessTypes (value, title, description, icon) are the cards, spendBands (value, label) fill the select and countries is a list of ISO codes written in locale. The business types sit in one column until the form itself is wide enough for two cards, and every required answer is marked as required for assistive technology. termsHref makes the words 'trade terms' a link, reviewDays is the promise (default 2) and defaultValues prefills. submitted shows the confirmation for answers a page has already taken: what was given, what happens next (the steps are in labels) and a link to shopHref. It is not a <form> element, because Radix inputs inside one make React warn in development, but Enter in a text field still sends it. Every word is in labels.
